Alex M: Heads-up — onboarding sample app is flapping on the rerank endpoint when the batching helper + auth retry logic both run. Getting vector-dim mismatch 400s.
Priya K: repro steps?
Alex M: Quick notes: we batch 6-8 queries in Node sampleapp, a transient auth retry re-queues the request and we sometimes end up with mixed vector lengths in the payload (1536 vs 1535). API responds with `400 embedding.length mismatch`.
Samir P: hmm classic TypedArray.view gotcha. Node's helper uses subarray to avoid copies; Python client builds fresh lists so it's fine. Which SDK version?
Alex M: Node SDK v0.9.2 in sampleapp. Tests were running Python 0.8.x. I can paste snippet:
```
// batch helper
const batches = batchify(vecs, 8)
await Promise.all(batches.map(b => send(b)))
// send requeues original req on retry
```
Alex M: On retry we re-use the same underlying ArrayBuffer view; later mutations shorten one vector and the requeued request carries the short slice.
Priya K: can you capture a minimal repro? if it's subarray we should either copy or ensure the retry path clones body.
Ethan L: opened PR #3421 — quick patch copies vectors before enqueue, and adds an integration that simulates auth 401->retry. CI shows one flaky test failing locally though.
Samir P: long-term fix: SDK retry middleware should deep-copy request bodies (or mark them immutable). Prefer to fix middleware so all helpers benefit.
Alex M: temporary mitigation: set env BATCH_RETRY_STRATEGY=single-send for the sampleapp to avoid requeueing batches. Not ideal for latency.
Priya K: API side: can we improve error text to include batch index? Current `embedding.length mismatch` is terse. Something like: `vector dims differ in payload (expected 1536 got 1535) at batch index 2` would help debugging.
Platform APIs: Noted. We can add batch-index to the error envelope in the next minor release, but need SDKs updated to read the new field gracefully.
Ethan L: after copying buffers in node helper, I hit a different issue — response envelope changed when rerank deduping kicks in (we return items out-of-order). Adding tests for stable ordering in PR.
Priya K: follow-up action items: 1) merge copy-in-enqueue fix (short term), 2) update retry middleware to deep-clone bodies (medium), 3) API error text change (coord w/ Platform APIs), 4) add node+py parity E2E for batching+retry.
CI Bot: PR #3421 pipeline passed :white_check_mark:
Alex M: deployed hotfix on staging — onboarding run passed end-to-end :tada:
Priya K: will open a tracking ticket for SDK lint rule to forbid subarray reuse for request bodies.
Samir P: also add a small note in the DX onboarding guide: "avoid reusing TypedArray.subarray for request bodies; clone if you'll retry".
Alex M: thanks all — leaving issue link in the sampleapp README.
